key_insight: By inverse-designing the optical pump in a topological photonic lattice, the authors can deterministically program both the dimensionality and modal structure of entangled biphoton states while retaining topological protection.
engineering_relevance: This enables application-specific quantum state generation for scalable photonic quantum computing, quantum networking, and high-dimensional quantum communication with improved robustness to fabrication disorder.
method: Engineer silicon photonic topological superlattices supporting co-localized interface modes.
Shape the nonlinear pump profile to selectively excite desired topological biphoton eigenstates.
Inverse-design pump superpositions to target specific Schmidt dimensionalities and correlation patterns.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports reproducible site-resolved two-photon correlation measurements across nominally identical devices, with successful selective addressing of eigenstates and target-state generation in a high-dimensional Hilbert space.
watch_item: Programmability is demonstrated on integrated silicon photonic devices, so practical deployment will still depend on precise pump shaping and maintaining performance as device complexity scales.
paper_title: Programmable Preparation of Topological Entangled States
